nginx.service.purpose: Serve the kitchen terminal web application

user_facing_inventory.audio: at least one ALSA playback PCM

safe_conditions_to_consider_manual_resta: two consecutive guard scans identify the same service-specific failure
SSH observation succeeded and the failure is not merely an observation error
the service dependency checks relevant to the failure are healthy
a human has reviewed current state and explicitly authorized the maintenance action
do_not_restart_when: SSH or the fixed probe failed
a dependency such as display, audio, network, or storage is the likely cause
multiple services fail in a pattern suggesting a shared dependency
the consequence or current user activity is uncertain
escalate_when: the same failure remains after an explicitly authorized manual restart
storage corruption, destructive action, privilege expansion, or configuration change is implicated
the kiosk loses display, touch, and audio together
the failure cannot be distinguished from an observation failure
